basic_info.description:
RARELY AVAILABLE very large one bedroom (~1000 sq ft) unit in Madrone, with gorgeous parkside views and peek-a-boo views of the bay and Sutro tower - your hidden garden retreat in the urban jungle of SF. This one bedroom not only has ample storage and closet space, it also features a nearly 12' long quartz countertop for entertaining, and is a private unit (no neighbor to either side of the unit or below) - a feeling of the quietness of a single family home in the convenience of downtown San Francisco! Fully equipped with custom and top of the line Thermador refrigerator and Bosch appliances, with upgraded gray oak hardwood flooring, wake up in the luxury of comfort and happiness everyday. Ample natural lighting with floor to ceiling windows spanning the entire livable area! Not to mention, a beautiful balcony overlooking Mission Bay Park.

Parking: The monthly rent INCLUDES one covered parking space in a secured, gated garage.

Minimum 1 year lease required. 
Maximum lease term (to lock in current rate) is 3 years.
Tenant pays for utilities (PG&E).
Tenant responsible for replacing lightbulbs as well as smoke detector/carbon monoxide batteries.
No smoking.
Tenant responsible for HOA move in fee and $50 transponder fee for garage access.
